note: trashslot 15.1.5 (1.20.1 -> 1.21.1). CenturyBridge tombstoned four ItemStack/NBT helpers at the 1.20.4->1.20.5 component boundary; the bridges below restore them with the 1.21.1 registry-aware ItemStack codec. STATUS: prepared but NOT boot-verified. With native Balm 21.0.66 the Balm.initialize call-site bridge is verified to advance boot, but the next failure is BalmNetworking.registerServerboundPacket(Identifier, Class, BiConsumer, Function, BiConsumer): Balm 21 networking is payload/PacketType/StreamCodec based, and the old API is gone. Do not treat these rules as passed until a real boot/contract exists (see runs/p15-trashslot/ and runs/p16-balm/).

callSiteAdaptations.evidence: Native Balm 21.0.66 (1.21.1) boot: NoSuchMethodError 'void net.blay09.mods.balm.api.Balm.initialize(java.lang.String, java.lang.Runnable)' at net.blay09.mods.trashslot.FabricTrashSlot.onInitialize (runs/p15-trashslot/server-trashslot3.log). Balm 21 replaced the two-arg initializer with initialize(String, BalmRuntimeLoadContext, Runnable) / initializeMod. TrashSlot is a normal mod initializer, so Balm's EmptyLoadContext.INSTANCE is the equivalent context; the bridge calls the new method.

methodRedirects.evidence: Conversion report work/cb/out/trashslot/report.md: tombstoned net/minecraft/class_1799.method_7953(NbtCompound)NbtCompound at 1.20.4->1.20.5. Real call site: net/blay09/mods/trashslot/TrashHelper.setTrashItem passes an ItemStack and a new NbtCompound to the tombstone, then stores that compound under TrashSlot in the player's persistent data; the bridge encodes with 1.21.1 ItemStack.CODEC + RegistryOps(NbtOps) and copies the resulting compound into the supplied one, preserving the old writeNbt mutation contract.

Conversion report: tombstoned net/minecraft/class_1799.method_7915(NbtCompound)ItemStack at 1.20.4->1.20.5. Real call site: TrashHelper.getTrashItem reads the TrashSlot compound and passes it to the tombstone. The bridge parses with 1.21.1 ItemStack.CODEC + RegistryOps(NbtOps), falling back to ItemStack.EMPTY on failure, which is the same empty-stack result the old fromNbt returned for an empty compound.

Conversion report: tombstoned net/minecraft/class_2540.method_10793(ItemStack)FriendlyByteBuf at 1.20.4->1.20.5. Real call sites: MessageTrashSlotClick.encode and MessageTrashSlotContent.encode pass an ItemStack. 1.21.1 FriendlyByteBuf dropped the item helpers; the bridge writes the ItemStack.CODEC NBT via FriendlyByteBuf.method_10794 (writeNbt). Both sides of the trashslot protocol are patched, so the internal packet format change is consistent.

Conversion report: tombstoned net/minecraft/class_2540.method_10819()ItemStack at 1.20.4->1.20.5. Real call sites: MessageTrashSlotClick.decode and MessageTrashSlotContent.decode. The bridge reads FriendlyByteBuf.method_10798 (readNbt) and parses ItemStack.CODEC with RegistryOps(NbtOps), matching the write side.
